entities.name: FRwL
entities.gloss: A cyber threat group also known as Z-Team and tracked as UAC-0118.

entities.gloss: A legitimate network scanning tool frequently impersonated by threat actors to distribute malware.

entities.name: Vidar
entities.gloss: An information-stealing malware designed to extract credentials, session data, and browser information from compromised devices.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based instant messaging application and platform.

entities.name: Netscan
entities.gloss: A network reconnaissance and scanning utility.

entities.name: Cobalt Strike Beacon
entities.gloss: A post-exploitation agent used by threat actors for command and control and lateral movement.

entities.name: Rclone
entities.gloss: An open-source command-line program to manage and synchronize files on cloud storage.

entities.name: Anydesk
entities.gloss: A remote desktop application used for remote access and management.

entities.name: Ngrok
entities.gloss: A cross-platform application that exposes local network ports to the internet through secure tunnels.
